title: Code Review and Quality Checks
learning_outcomes: Explain the role of code review and quality checks in a jQuery application.
Apply readability and naming in a small example and describe its expected result.
Verify avoiding duplicate logic with an explicit test or browser observation.
status_note: Draft generated from the attached syllabus and official references; requires lesson-by-lesson technical review, local execution, accessibility checks, and editorial approval.

content.intro: Use this lesson on code review and quality checks as a professional review habit: identify the relevant behavior, make one controlled change, and verify its outcome.
content.why_it_matters: This topic is useful because it turns readability and naming into a repeatable implementation choice. Debug through reproducible steps, browser tools, focused assertions, and regression tests. QUnit can test DOM behavior and asynchronous results without assuming that a single passing unit test proves the whole application.

content_blocks.expected_output: The console remains quiet when the expected DOM text is present and emits an assertion message if not.
content_blocks.run_instructions: Use a local HTML page with jQuery 4.0.0 loaded before app.js for JavaScript snippets. HTML and package-manager snippets can be checked as configuration examples. Run the interaction in browser DevTools, inspect the DOM/Network panel, and compare actual behavior with the expected result. Do not submit learner code to the production API for arbitrary execution.
content_blocks.reset_steps: Restore the original markup and code, clear console/network filters, reload the local page, and repeat the same interaction. For a request example, return the mock endpoint to its original response before retrying.

content_blocks.title: Guided example
content_blocks.text: Start with a known DOM structure, apply the pattern for code review and quality checks, and test one normal case plus one edge case. Keep selectors scoped to the intended component and verify the real browser result.

content_blocks.title: Try it yourself
content_blocks.text: Write a focused verification case for code review and quality checks. Include a success path and a failure or edge case; record what the test does not cover.

content.task: Write a focused verification case for code review and quality checks. Include a success path and a failure or edge case; record what the test does not cover.
task_acceptance_criteria: The implementation demonstrates code review and quality checks using a current, documented approach.
The learner records the expected and actual behavior and checks at least one edge case.
The example preserves semantic HTML and does not render untrusted data as HTML.
The test setup and any runtime limitation are documented honestly.
hints: First identify which DOM nodes and runtime state are involved in code review and quality checks.
Make one small change, inspect the resulting element or request, and compare it with the expected result.
If the result differs, check the selector, script order, browser console, event target, and relevant API documentation before adding more code.
content.expected_output: The console remains quiet when the expected DOM text is present and emits an assertion message if not.
common_mistakes: Assuming a selector matched an element without checking the collection length.
Confusing jQuery collections with native DOM elements or live properties with markup attributes.
Using .html() with untrusted data or assuming client-side validation enforces server rules.
Treating a demo snippet as production-ready without testing failure and accessibility states.
summary: Code Review and Quality Checks is one part of the debugging, testing, and quality assurance workflow.

Debug through reproducible steps, browser tools, focused assertions, and regression tests. QUnit can test DOM behavior and asynchronous results without assuming that a single passing unit test proves the whole application.
Use the official API or upgrade guide for version-specific behavior and verify an example locally before relying on it.
